reuse.why: Extends the existing WeekendRule/applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend path for holidays and reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule and dayFromDate in the new handler, though it does not reuse a common 'next valid occurrence' step across its three skip sites.

duplication.why: The daily-skip filter (skipsDays && isWeekendOrHoliday) is re-applied separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, and two different search-window helpers (getSkipSearchDepth and getMaxShiftDays) encode the same holiday-extension arithmetic.

placement.why: Weekend/holiday predicates live in shared/schedules.ts and the handler sits beside get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts, but getMaxShiftDays stays private in app.ts next to its shared sibling getSkipSearchDepth.

scope.why: Changes stay on the four requested steps; only a cosmetic import reorder is unrelated.

maintainability.why: Holiday handling is centralised, but the daily-skip rule is spread over three call sites and schedule-template now overloads getNextDate's noSkipWeekend flag with a computed value, which is hard to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend moves go through applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the skip rule uses the shared skipsWeekendOccurrences/isWeekendOrHoliday predicates.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily-skip filtering written as .find in getNextDate, .filter/.slice in getUpcomingDates and a for/continue loop in getDatesInRange; getMaxShiftDays (app.ts) restates getSkipSearchDepth's 2-per-holiday window.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays and WeekendRule gains holidays; getNextDate gains a skipsDays daily branch; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange each implement their own skip filtering and search depth instead of a shared occurrence helper.
